invariant: a worker slot is owned only by the chat that successfully created its dedicated slot branch; existing slot branches may never be adopted by another chat

protocols.slot_allocation: anonymous chat attempts create_branch for W1 then W2 then W3 then W4 using dedicated immutable slot branch names; the first create_branch success establishes that chat's worker slot; an already-existing branch is a collision, never ownership
protocols.registration_marker: after successful slot-branch creation, create a fixed marker file on that slot branch; resulting commit SHA is the durable registration_commit for that chat
protocols.durable_registration: record worker slot, registration_branch and registration_commit into shared state through exact-head CAS
protocols.resume: chat may act for a worker only if it previously observed successful creation of that slot branch and its retained registration_commit matches durable state; otherwise fail closed
protocols.action_claim: claim one PENDING action through exact-head CAS and record both owner_worker and owner_registration_commit
